compilation.title_en: Ḥadīth Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna
compilation.edition: Dār al-Ṣaḥāba lil-Turāth, Ṭanṭā, First edition, 1412 AH – 1992 CE
compilation.description_en: A fascicle of fifty narrations of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna (d. 198 AH) in the transmission of Zakariyyā ibn Yaḥyā al-Marwazī. The printed edition adds an editor’s introduction and study before the text and audition notes (samāʿāt) after it; both are kept apart from the narrations.

notes.text: The source opens with the editor’s introduction, methodology and biographies, then the fascicle with narrations 1 to 50, then audition notes (samāʿāt). The supplied file holds 82 page records.

notes.label: English translation
notes.text: English translations are added as *_english fields; all original Arabic fields, IDs, and metadata are unchanged. Honorifics are rendered with Unicode ligatures; “Allah” is rendered “God” except within proper names (e.g., ʿAbd Allāh, Hibat Allāh). Square brackets in the English mark either the source’s own bracketed text or a brief translator’s clarification; unclear or garbled source readings are transliterated as they stand.

notes.label: Arabic text
notes.text: The Arabic is shown exactly as supplied. Where an entry opens with its printed number, the number appears in the label instead of the text. Square brackets and page markers are carried over from the source.

notes.label: Isnad and matn
notes.text: Where the Arabic gives a chain before the words, the chain and the words are shown apart and the English is divided at the same point. Entries with no chain say so. The division follows a fixed rule and does not alter the text.

notes.label: Dating

records.text_en: Riyāḍ al-Janna (The Gardens of Paradise) for the Takhrīj of the Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna (d. 198 AH), transmitted by Abū Yaḥyā Zakariyyā ibn Yaḥyā ibn Asad al-Marwazī (d. 270 AH). Edited, with its ḥadīths traced, by Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān Misʿad ibn ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd al-Saʿdanī al-Sharqāwī al-Salafī, may God pardon him and his parents. Dār al-Ṣaḥāba lil-Turāth, Ṭanṭā. First edition, 1412 AH – 1992 CE.

records.text_ar: مُقَدّمَة بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم إِن الْحَمد لله، نحمده ونستعينه، وَنَسْتَغْفِرهُ، ونعوذ بِاللَّه من شرور أَنْفُسنَا، وَمن سيئات أَعمالنَا، من يهده الله فَلَا مضل لَهُ، وَمن يضلل فَلَا هادي لَهُ. ثمَّ أما بعد: فجزء "سُفْيَان بن عُيَيْنَة " من بَين تراثنا الاسلامي الحديثي المهم، وَذَلِكَ لأسباب عدَّة، مِنْهَا على سَبِيل الْمِثَال، لَا الْحصْر: 1 - علو الْجُزْء، وَهِي ميزة مهمة، تنفرد بهَا تِلْكَ الْأَجْزَاء الْعَظِيمَة. 2 - وجود بعض الطّرق المهمة الَّتِي قد تصحح، أَو تحسن، الحَدِيث، وَهَذِه أَيْضا من أهم الميزات الجليلة الَّتِي تُوجد فِي تِلْكَ الْأَجْزَاء. 3 - وجود بعض الْفَوَائِد العزيزة الَّتِي لَا تُوجد إِلَّا فِي تِلْكَ الْأَجْزَاء. وَغير ذَلِك من الْأَسْبَاب المهمة الَّتِي دفعتني إِلَى النّظر فِي مَجْمُوعَة من الْأَجْزَاء الحديثية، وَمِنْهَا هَذَا الْجُزْء الْقيم. وقديما قَالُوا: "تَحْقِيق مخطوط جليل خير من تأليف كتاب هزيل". وَلذَا فقد آثرت الأولى على الثَّانِيَة، مُعْتَمدًا فِي ذَلِك على عون الله تَعَالَى وتوفيقه، إِنَّه على ذَلِك لقدير.
records.text_en: Introduction. In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. Praise belongs to God; we praise Him, seek His help, and ask His forgiveness, and we seek refuge in God from the evils of our souls and from our evil deeds. Whomever God guides, none can lead astray, and whomever He leads astray, none can guide. To proceed: The fascicle of “Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna” is among the important ḥadīth heritage of Islam, for several reasons, among them, by way of example and not exhaustive enumeration: 1 - The elevation of the fascicle (ʿuluww al-juzʾ), an important feature unique to these great fascicles. 2 - The presence of some important chains of transmission that may render a ḥadīth sound (ṣaḥīḥ) or fair (ḥasan); this too is among the most noble features found in these fascicles. 3 - The presence of some rare benefits that are found only in these fascicles. And there are other important reasons that prompted me to examine a group of ḥadīth fascicles, among them this valuable fascicle. They said of old: “Editing a venerable manuscript is better than composing a feeble book.” So I have preferred the former over the latter, relying upon the help of God Most High and His grant of success; indeed, He is capable of all things.

records.text_ar: ‌ ‌تَعْرِيف الْجُزْء والجزء فِي اللُّغَة: من الشئ. وَكَذَا: مَا يتركب الشئ مِنْهُ وَمن غَيره، وَكَذَا: النَّصِيب. وَجمعه: أَجزَاء. انْظُر: " المعجم الْوَسِيط " (1 / 124) و " مُخْتَار الصِّحَاح " (101، 102) و " الْمِصْبَاح الْمُنِير " (1 / 137 - 138 - ط. المطبعة الأميرية) . وفى الِاصْطِلَاح: هُوَ كتاب صَغِير يشْتَمل على أحد الْأَمريْنِ: الأول: هُوَ جمع الْأَحَادِيث المروية عَن وَاحِد من الصَّحَابَة، أَو من بعدهمْ مثل: (أ) " جُزْء مَا رَوَاهُ أَبُو حنيفَة عَن الصَّحَابَة " لأبي معشر عبد الْكَرِيم بن عبد الصَّمد الطَّبَرِيّ الْمُتَوفَّى سنة 478 هـ. (ب) " جُزْء فِيهِ حَدِيث أبي العشراء الدَّارمِيّ " لأبي الْقَاسِم تَمام بن مُحَمَّد الرَّازِيّ الْمُتَوفَّى سنة 414 هـ. الثَّانِي: جمع مَا رَوَاهُ بعض الْأَئِمَّة الْحفاظ من أَحَادِيث تتَعَلَّق بموضوع وَاحِد على سَبِيل الْبسط وَالِاسْتِقْصَاء، مثل: (أ) جُزْء رفع الْيَدَيْنِ فِي الصَّلَاة. (ب) جُزْء الْقِرَاءَة خلف الإِمَام. كِلَاهُمَا للْإِمَام البُخَارِيّ. وَغير ذَلِك من الْأَجْزَاء العديدة: انْظُر: " أصُول التَّخْرِيج ودراسة الْأَسَانِيد " للدكتور: مَحْمُود الطَّحَّان (137 - ط. دَار الْكتب السلفية) .
records.text_en: Definition of the Juzʾ. The word juzʾ in the language means a part of a thing; likewise, that of which a thing and other things are composed; likewise, a share. Its plural is ajzāʾ. See: al-Muʿjam al-Wasīṭ (1/124), Mukhtār al-Ṣiḥāḥ (101, 102), and al-Miṣbāḥ al-Munīr (1/137–138, al-Maṭbaʿa al-Amīriyya edition). In technical usage: it is a small book comprising one of two things: First: a collection of the ḥadīths narrated from one of the Companions, or from those after them, such as: (a) “Juzʾ of What Abū Ḥanīfa Narrated from the Companions” by Abū Maʿshar ʿAbd al-Karīm ibn ʿAbd al-Ṣamad al-Ṭabarī, who died in 478 AH. (b) “A Juzʾ Containing the Ḥadīth of Abū al-ʿUshārāʾ al-Dārimī” by Abū al-Qāsim Tammām ibn Muḥammad al-Rāzī, who died in 414 AH. Second: a collection of what some of the leading memorizers among the imams narrated of ḥadīths relating to a single topic, treated extensively and exhaustively, such as: (a) the juzʾ on raising the hands in prayer; (b) the juzʾ on recitation behind the imam. Both are by Imam al-Bukhārī. And there are many other fascicles of this kind. See: “Uṣūl al-Takhrīj wa-Dirāsat al-Asānīd” by Dr. Maḥmūd al-Ṭaḥḥān (137, Dār al-Kutub al-Salafiyya edition).

records.text_ar: ‌ ‌مَنْهَج التَّحْقِيق وَكَانَ منهجي فِي التَّحْقِيق على النَّحْو التَّالِي: 1 - ترجمت لصَاحب الْجُزْء، سُفْيَان بن عُيَيْنَة رَحمَه الله تَعَالَى. 2 - ترجمت لراوي ذَلِك الْجُزْء أبي يحيى زَكَرِيَّا بن يحيى الْمروزِي. 3 - ترجمت لرواة السَّنَد جَمِيعهم. 4 - خرجت مَا فِي الْجُزْء من أَحَادِيث وآثار، وَذَلِكَ حسب الطَّاقَة. 5 - قُمْت بتقويم النَّص، وَتَصْحِيح متن الْكتاب، وَذَلِكَ من الْمُهِمَّات الصعبة 6 - شرحت مَا فِي الْأَحَادِيث من الْغَرِيب، والمبهم غير الْمَفْهُوم. 7 - تَكَلَّمت على بعض الْأَحَادِيث من النَّاحِيَة الْفِقْهِيَّة. 8 - ذكرت مَا فِيهِ - أَي الْجُزْء - من الْفَوَائِد الحديثية. 9 - صنعت الفهارس العلمية الْخَاصَّة بذلك. وأخيرا أسأَل الله العون والمدد إِنَّه على ذَلِك لقدير. وَكتبه: أَبُو عبد الرَّحْمَن مسعد بن عبد الحميد بن مُحَمَّد السعدني الشرقاوي السلَفِي عَفا الله عَنهُ وَعَن وَالِديهِ
records.text_en: Methodology of the Edition. My methodology in the edition was as follows: 1 - I provided a biography of the author of the fascicle, Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna ﵀. 2 - I provided a biography of the narrator of this fascicle, Abū Yaḥyā Zakariyyā ibn Yaḥyā al-Marwazī. 3 - I provided biographies of all the narrators of the chain of transmission. 4 - I traced the ḥadīths and reports (āthār) contained in the fascicle, to the extent of my ability. 5 - I established the text and corrected the body of the book, which is among the difficult tasks. 6 - I explained the rare words (gharīb) and the obscure, unintelligible matters in the ḥadīths. 7 - I commented on some of the ḥadīths from the juristic perspective. 8 - I mentioned the ḥadīth-related benefits that it — that is, the fascicle — contains. 9 - I prepared the scholarly indexes for it. Finally, I ask God for help and support; indeed, He is capable of that. Written by: Abū ʿAbd al-Raḥmān Misʿad ibn ʿAbd al-Ḥamīd ibn Muḥammad al-Saʿdanī al-Sharqāwī al-Salafī, may God pardon him and his parents.

records.text_ar: ‌ ‌تَرْجَمَة صَاحب الْجُزْء سُفْيَان بن عُيَيْنَة هُوَ: الإِمَام شيخ الْإِسْلَام والمحدثين، وَعلم من أَعْلَام الْأمة أَبُو مُحَمَّد سُفْيَان بن عُيَيْنَة بن مَيْمُون بن أبي عمرَان الْهِلَالِي الْكُوفِي الْمَكِّيّ. ولد بِالْكُوفَةِ سنة 107 هـ. وسُفْيَان مَعْدُود فِي الْكُوفِيّين، وَفِي الموالى، وَوَلَاؤُهُ لمُحَمد بن مُزَاحم أخي الضَّحَّاك بن مُزَاحم، وَكَانَ أَعور، وَقيل إِن أَبَا عُيَيْنَة كَانَ يكنى بِأبي عمرَان. وَقد سمع سُفْيَان كل من: عَمْرو بن دِينَار، وَإِبْرَاهِيم بن عقبَة، وَإِسْحَاق بن عبد الله بن أبي طَلْحَة، وَإِسْمَاعِيل بن أبي خَالِد، وَأَيوب السجسْتانِي، وزَكَرِيا بن أبي زَائِدَة، وَسَلَمَة ابْن دِينَار، وَعبد الله بن طَاوس، وَأبي إِسْحَاق السبيعِي، وَالزهْرِيّ، وَزيد ابْن علاقَة، وَالْأسود بن قيس، وَعبيد الله بن أبي يزِيد، وَعَاصِم بن أبي النجُود، وَزيد بن أسلم، وَابْن الْمُنْكَدر، وَآخَرين. وروى عَنهُ: الْأَعْمَش، وَابْن جريج، وَشعْبَة وهم من شُيُوخه، وَأحمد بن صَالح الْمصْرِيّ، وَإِسْحَاق بن رَاهَوَيْه، وَعلي بن الْمَدِينِيّ، وَأبي كريب مُحَمَّد بن الْعَلَاء، وَزُهَيْر بن مُعَاوِيَة، وَيَعْقُوب بن إِبْرَاهِيم، وَحَمَّاد بن زيد، وَابْن الْمُبَارك، وَعبد الرَّزَّاق الْحميدِي، وزَكَرِيا بن يحيى بن أَسد الْمروزِي - رَاوِي هَذَا الْجُزْء -، وَبشر بن مطر، وَالزُّبَيْر بن بكار، وَأحمد بن شَيبَان، وَآخَرين.
records.text_en: Biography of the Author of the Fascicle, Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna. He is: the imam, Shaykh of Islam and of the ḥadīth scholars, and one of the luminaries of the community, Abū Muḥammad Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna ibn Maymūn ibn Abī ʿImrān al-Hilālī al-Kūfī al-Makkī. He was born in Kūfa in the year 107 AH. Sufyān is counted among the Kūfans and among the mawālī (clients), his clientship being to Muḥammad ibn Muzāḥim, brother of al-Ḍaḥḥāk ibn Muzāḥim. He was blind in one eye, and it is said that Abū ʿUyayna was known by the kunya Abū ʿImrān. Sufyān heard from each of the following: ʿAmr ibn Dīnār, Ibrāhīm ibn ʿUqba, Isḥāq ibn ʿAbd Allāh ibn Abī Ṭalḥa, Ismāʿīl ibn Abī Khālid, Ayyūb al-Sijistānī, Zakariyyā ibn Abī Zāʾida, Salama ibn Dīnār, ʿAbd Allāh ibn Ṭāwūs, Abū Isḥāq al-Sabīʿī, al-Zuhrī, Zayd ibn ʿIlāqa, al-Aswad ibn Qays, ʿUbayd Allāh ibn Abī Yazīd, ʿĀṣim ibn Abī al-Najūd, Zayd ibn Aslam, Ibn al-Munkadir, and others. Narrating from him were: al-Aʿmash, Ibn Jurayj, and Shuʿba — who were among his own shaykhs — as well as Aḥmad ibn Ṣāliḥ al-Miṣrī, Isḥāq ibn Rāhawayh, ʿAlī ibn al-Madīnī, Abū Kurayb Muḥammad ibn al-ʿAlāʾ, Zuhayr ibn Muʿāwiya, Yaʿqūb ibn Ibrāhīm, Ḥammād ibn Zayd, Ibn al-Mubārak, ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ḥumaydī, Zakariyyā ibn Yaḥyā ibn Asad al-Marwazī — the narrator of this fascicle —, Bishr ibn Muṭar, al-Zubayr ibn Bakkār, Aḥmad ibn Shaybān, and others.

records.text_ar: وَقد أثنى عَلَيْهِ الْعلمَاء: فَقَالَ على بن الْمَدِينِيّ كَمَا فِي " تَارِيخ بَغْدَاد " (9 / 178) : " لم يكن فِي أَصْحَاب الزُّهْرِيّ أتقن مِنْهُ ". وَقَالَ الْعجلِيّ: " كُوفِي، ثِقَة، ثَبت فِي الحَدِيث ". وَقَالَ الشَّافِعِي: " لَوْلَا مَالك، وسُفْيَان لذهب علم الْحجاز ". وَسُئِلَ عَنهُ ابْن الْمُبَارك فَقَالَ: " ذَاك أحد الأحدين ". وَقَالَ الشَّافِعِي أَيْضا: " مَا رَأَيْت أحدا أكف عَن الْفتيا مِنْهُ ". وَقَالَ ابْن وهب: " مَا رَأَيْت أحدا أعلم بِكِتَاب الله من ابْن عُيَيْنَة ". وَقيل لعَلي بن الْمَدِينِيّ: " هُوَ إِمَام فِي الحَدِيث؟ ". فَقَالَ رحمه الله: " هُوَ إِمَام مُنْذُ أَرْبَعِينَ سنة ". وَقيل ليحيى بن معِين: ابْن عُيَيْنَة أحب إِلَيْك فِي عَمْرو بن دِينَار، أَو الثَّوْريّ؟ فَقَالَ: ابْن عُيَيْنَة أعلم بِهِ، فَقيل لَهُ: فَابْن عُيَيْنَة أحب إِلَيْك فِيهِ أَو حَمَّاد بن زيد؟ قَالَ: ابْن عُيَيْنَة أعلم بِهِ. قيل لَهُ: فشعبة؟ قَالَ: " وأيش روى عَنهُ شُعْبَة؟ إِنَّمَا روى عَنهُ نَحوا من مئة حَدِيث ". وَقَالَ أَحْمد بن حَنْبَل: " كَانَ إِذا سُئِلَ عَن الْمَنَاسِك سهل عَلَيْهِ، وَإِذا سُئِلَ عَن الطَّلَاق اشْتَدَّ عَلَيْهِ ". ولسفيان رحمه الله تَفْسِير لِلْقُرْآنِ، وَهُوَ مطبوع وَالْحَمْد لله. وَتوفى رَحمَه الله تَعَالَى فِي يَوْم السبت أول شهر رَجَب سنة ثَمَان وَتِسْعين وَمِائَة من الْهِجْرَة بِمَكَّة المكرمة. رحمه الله رَحْمَة وَاسِعَة. ولمزيد من التَّفْصِيل ينظر الْآتِي: 1 - طَبَقَات ابْن سعد (5 / 497 - وَمَا بعْدهَا) . 2 - التَّارِيخ الْكَبِير للْبُخَارِيّ (4 / 94) .
records.text_en: The scholars praised him. ʿAlī ibn al-Madīnī said, as in Tārīkh Baghdād (9/178): “Among the companions of al-Zuhrī there was none more precise than he.” Al-ʿIjlī said: “A Kūfan, reliable (thiqa), firmly established in ḥadīth.” Al-Shāfiʿī said: “Were it not for Mālik and Sufyān, the knowledge of the Ḥijāz would have vanished.” Ibn al-Mubārak was asked about him and said: “He is one of the singular ones.” Al-Shāfiʿī also said: “I have not seen anyone more restrained from issuing legal opinions (fatwā) than he.” Ibn Wahb said: “I have not seen anyone more knowledgeable of the Book of God than Ibn ʿUyayna.” It was said to ʿAlī ibn al-Madīnī: “Is he an imam in ḥadīth?” He ﵀ said: “He has been an imam for forty years.” It was said to Yaḥyā ibn Maʿīn: “Do you prefer Ibn ʿUyayna regarding ʿAmr ibn Dīnār, or al-Thawrī?” He said: “Ibn ʿUyayna knew him better.” It was said to him: “Then do you prefer Ibn ʿUyayna regarding him, or Ḥammād ibn Zayd?” He said: “Ibn ʿUyayna knew him better.” It was said to him: “And Shuʿba?” He said: “And what did Shuʿba narrate from him? He narrated only about a hundred ḥadīths from him.” Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal said: “When he was asked about the rites of pilgrimage (manāsik), he was lenient, and when he was asked about divorce, he was strict.” Sufyān ﵀ has a Qurʾānic exegesis (tafsīr), which is printed, praise be to God. He ﵀ died on Saturday, the first of the month of Rajab, in the year 198 of the Hijra, in Mecca the Venerated. ﵀ — with a vast mercy. For further detail, see the following: 1 - Ṭabaqāt Ibn Saʿd (5/497 ff.). 2 - al-Tārīkh al-Kabīr by al-Bukhārī (4/94).

records.text_ar: ‌ ‌تَرْجَمَة رَاوِي الْجُزْء زَكَرِيَّا بن يحيى الْمروزِي هُوَ: الشَّيْخ الْمُحدث الصدوق: أَبُو يحيى زَكَرِيَّا بن يحيى بن أَسد الْمروزِي نزيل بَغْدَاد الملقب بزكرويه. روى عَن: سُفْيَان بن عُيَيْنَة، وَأبي مُعَاوِيَة الضَّرِير، ومعروف الْكَرْخِي. وَعنهُ حدث: القَاضِي الْمحَامِلِي، وَمُحَمّد بن مخلد، وَأَبُو الْعَبَّاس الْأَصَم، وَإِسْمَاعِيل الصفار، وَأَبُو عوَانَة، وَآخَرُونَ. قَالَ فِيهِ الدَّارَقُطْنِيّ: " لَا بَأْس بِهِ ". وَقَالَ فِيهِ الذَّهَبِيّ: " الشَّيْخ الْمُحدث الصدوق … ". مَاتَ فِي شهر ربيع الآخر سنة 270 هـ. وَقَالَ الذَّهَبِيّ: " لَعَلَّه قَارب الْمِائَة ". انْظُر: 1 - " تَارِيخ بَغْدَاد " للخطيب (8 / 460 - 461) . 2 - " المنتظم " لِابْنِ الْجَوْزِيّ (5 / 77) . 3 - شذرات الذَّهَب (2 / 160) . 4 - " سير أَعْلَام النبلاء " (12 / 347) . 5 - " العبر " (2 / 45) . 6 - ميزَان الِاعْتِدَال (2 / 80) . وَغير ذَلِك. وفى تَرْجَمته من " السّير " قَالَ الإِمَام الذَّهَبِيّ رحمه الله:
records.text_en: Biography of the Narrator of the Fascicle, Zakariyyā ibn Yaḥyā al-Marwazī. He is: the shaykh, the muḥaddith, the truthful (ṣadūq), Abū Yaḥyā Zakariyyā ibn Yaḥyā ibn Asad al-Marwazī, resident of Baghdad, nicknamed Zakarawayh. He narrated from: Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna, Abū Muʿāwiya al-Ḍarīr, and Maʿrūf al-Karkhī. Narrating from him: the judge al-Maḥāmilī, Muḥammad ibn Makhlad, Abū al-ʿAbbās al-Aṣamm, Ismāʿīl al-Ṣaffār, Abū ʿAwāna, and others. Al-Dāraquṭnī said of him: “There is no harm in him.” Al-Dhahabī said of him: “The shaykh, the muḥaddith, the truthful …” He died in the month of Rabīʿ al-Ākhir in the year 270 AH. Al-Dhahabī said: “Perhaps he approached a hundred years of age.” See: 1 - Tārīkh Baghdād by al-Khaṭīb (8/460–461). 2 - al-Muntaẓam by Ibn al-Jawzī (5/77). 3 - Shadharāt al-Dhahab (2/160). 4 - Siyar Aʿlām al-Nubalāʾ (12/347). 5 - al-ʿIbar (2/45). 6 - Mīzān al-Iʿtidāl (2/80). records.text_ar: "وَهُوَ صَاحب: [جُزْء ابْن عُيَيْنَة] الَّذِي عِنْد السلَفِي ". وفى ذَلِك تَوْثِيق لذَلِك الْجُزْء المهم، وَمِنْهَا يفهم أَنه من رِوَايَة أَبى يحيى زَكَرِيَّا بن يحيى الْمروزِي رَحمَه الله تَعَالَى. ‌ ‌تَرْجَمَة رُوَاة سَنَد الْجُزْء ويروى ذَلِك الْجُزْء من طَرِيق: الْحَافِظ ابْن حجر رَحمَه الله تَعَالَى، الَّذِي يرويهِ عَن أبي مُحَمَّد عبد الْوَاحِد الصروي، الَّذِي يرويهِ عَن أبي الْحسن على الواني، الَّذِي يرويهِ عَن أبي الْقَاسِم الطرابلسي، الَّذِي يرويهِ عَن جده لأمه أَبى طَاهِر السلَفِي، الَّذِي يرويهِ عَن أبي الْحسن مكي بن مَنْصُور الكرجي، الَّذِي يرويهِ عَن أبي بكر الْحِيرِي، الَّذِي يرويهِ عَن أبي الْعَبَّاس الْأَصَم، الَّذِي يرويهِ عَن أبي يحيى زَكَرِيَّا بن يحيى الْمروزِي عَن سُفْيَان بن عُيَيْنَة بِهِ. فَيكون المنظر أَو التسلسل الحديثي هَكَذَا: 1 - جُزْء سُفْيَان بن عُيَيْنَة: 2 - رِوَايَة: أَبى يحيى زَكَرِيَّا بن يحيى الْمروزِي عَنهُ: 3 - رِوَايَة: أَبى الْعَبَّاس الْأَصَم عَنهُ: 4 - رِوَايَة: أَبى بكر الْحَرَشِي الْحِيرِي عَنهُ: 5 - رِوَايَة: أَبى الْحسن الكرجي عَنهُ: 6 - رِوَايَة: أَبى طَاهِر السلَفِي عَنهُ: 7 - رِوَايَة: أَبى الْقَاسِم الطرابلسي عَنهُ: 8 - رِوَايَة: أَبى الْحسن الواني عَنهُ: 9 - رِوَايَة: أَبى مُحَمَّد الصروي عَنهُ:
records.text_en: “He is the transmitter of the [Fascicle of Ibn ʿUyayna] that is held by al-Silafī.” In this is an authentication of this important fascicle, and from it one understands that it is from the transmission of Abū Yaḥyā Zakariyyā ibn Yaḥyā al-Marwazī ﵀. Biographies of the Narrators of the Chain of Transmission of the Fascicle. This fascicle is transmitted through: al-Ḥāfiẓ Ibn Ḥajar ﵀, who narrates it from Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd al-Wāḥid al-Ṣarawī, who narrates it from Abū al-Ḥasan ʿAlī al-Wānī, who narrates it from Abū al-Qāsim al-Ṭarābulusī, who narrates it from his maternal grandfather Abū Ṭāhir al-Silafī, who narrates it from Abū al-Ḥasan Makkī ibn Manṣūr al-Karajī, who narrates it from Abū Bakr al-Ḥīrī, who narrates it from Abū al-ʿAbbās al-Aṣamm, who narrates it from Abū Yaḥyā Zakariyyā ibn Yaḥyā al-Marwazī, from Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna, with it. So the outline, or the ḥadīth sequence, is as follows: 1 - The Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna: 2 - The transmission of Abū Yaḥyā Zakariyyā ibn Yaḥyā al-Marwazī from him: 3 - The transmission of Abū al-ʿAbbās al-Aṣamm from him: 4 - The transmission of Abū Bakr al-Ḥarashī al-Ḥīrī from him: 5 - The transmission of Abū al-Ḥasan al-Karajī from him: 6 - The transmission of Abū Ṭāhir al-Silafī from him: 7 - The transmission of Abū al-Qāsim al-Ṭarābulusī from him: 8 - The transmission of Abū al-Ḥasan al-Wānī from him: 9 - The transmission of Abū Muḥammad al-Ṣarawī from him:

records.text_ar: 10 - رِوَايَة: الْحَافِظ ابْن حجر عَنهُ. وَإِلَيْك تَرْجَمَة كل وَاحِد مِمَّن ذكرنَا آنِفا، وَذَلِكَ للتأكد من تَوْثِيق ذَلِك الْجُزْء الْقيم، وَيعلم كل وَاحِد من الباحثين أَن ذَلِك الْجُزْء من الْأَجْزَاء الموثقة حَقًا. وَالله من وَرَاء الْقَصْد، وَهُوَ يهدى السَّبِيل. ‌ ‌1 - تَرْجَمَة الْحَافِظ ابْن حجر الْعَسْقَلَانِي هُوَ شيخ الْإِسْلَام، خَاتِمَة الْحفاظ، وَإِمَام الْمُحدثين فِي زَمَانه أَحْمد بن عَليّ ابْن مُحَمَّد بن عَليّ بن أَحْمد الْكِنَانِي، الْعَسْقَلَانِي، الْمَعْرُوف بِابْن حجر الْعَسْقَلَانِي. ولد بِمصْر سنة 773 هـ، وَطلب علم الحَدِيث من سنة 794 هـ، فَسمع الْكثير، ورحل، ولازم شَيْخه أَبَا الْفضل الْعِرَاقِيّ، وَابْنه زين الدَّين الْعِرَاقِيّ. وشيوخه رَحمَه الله تَعَالَى كثير وَالْعدَد، وَقد ترْجم لَهُم فِي كِتَابه " الْمجمع المؤسس بالمعجم المفهرس " وَهُوَ من مخطوطات دَار الْكتب المصرية العامرة، وَمن شُيُوخه: أَبى إِسْحَاق إِبْرَاهِيم بن أَحْمد التنوخي البعلبكي، وَقد أَخذ عَنهُ علم الْقرَاءَات، والزين الْعِرَاقِيّ ابْن الْحَافِظ الْعِرَاقِيّ وَأخذ عَنهُ عُلُوم الحَدِيث، وَكَذَا الهيثمي والبلقيني، ومجد الدَّين الفيروز آبادي صَاحب الْقَامُوس فِي اللُّغَة أَخذ عَنهُ اللُّغَة، والعز بن جمَاعَة، وَمن أبي هُرَيْرَة عبد الرَّحْمَن بن الْحَافِظ الذَّهَبِيّ، وَمن النِّسَاء من مَرْيَم بنت الْأَذْرَعِيّ المقدسية. وَله شُيُوخ غَيرهم كثير. وَمن تلاميذه: شيخ الْإِسْلَام زَكَرِيَّا بن مُحَمَّد الْأنْصَارِيّ خَاتِمَة الْمُحدثين، وشمس الدَّين أَبى الْخَيْر مُحَمَّد بن عبد الرَّحْمَن السخاوي الإِمَام الْمَعْرُوف، وَقد سمع مِنْهُ ذَلِك الْجُزْء كَمَا فِي سماعات الْجُزْء بِآخِرهِ، وَمن تلاميذه أَيْضا: الْعِزّ بن فَهد، والبرهان البقاعي، والشرف عبد الْحق السنباطي رَحِمهم الله تَعَالَى.
records.text_en: 10 - The transmission of al-Ḥāfiẓ Ibn Ḥajar from him. Here is the biography of each of those we have mentioned above, in order to verify the authentication of this valuable fascicle, so that every researcher may know that this fascicle is truly among the authenticated fascicles. God is behind the intention, and He guides to the path. 1 - Biography of al-Ḥāfiẓ Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī. He is: the Shaykh of Islam, the seal of the memorizers, and the imam of the ḥadīth scholars of his time, Aḥmad ibn ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Aḥmad al-Kinānī al-ʿAsqalānī, known as Ibn Ḥajar al-ʿAsqalānī. He was born in Egypt in the year 773 AH and sought ḥadīth knowledge from the year 794 AH; he heard much, traveled, and attached himself to his shaykh Abū al-Faḍl al-ʿIrāqī and his son Zayn al-Dīn al-ʿIrāqī. His shaykhs ﵀ were numerous, and he gave their biographies in his book al-Majmaʿ al-Muʾassas bi-l-Muʿjam al-Mufahras, which is among the manuscripts of the flourishing Dār al-Kutub al-Miṣriyya. Among his shaykhs: Abū Isḥāq Ibrāhīm ibn Aḥmad al-Tanūkhī al-Baʿlabakkī, from whom he took the science of the Qirāʾāt (recitations); Zayn al-Dīn al-ʿIrāqī, son of al-Ḥāfiẓ al-ʿIrāqī, from whom he took the ḥadīth sciences; likewise al-Haythamī and al-Bulqīnī; Majd al-Dīn al-Fīrūzābādī, author of al-Qāmūs in lexicography, from whom he took language; al-ʿIzz ibn Jamāʿa; and from Abū Hurayra ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥāfiẓ al-Dhahabī; and among women, from Maryam bint al-Adhraʿī al-Maqdisiyya. He has many other shaykhs besides these. Among his students: Shaykh al-Islām Zakariyyā ibn Muḥammad al-Anṣārī, the seal of the ḥadīth scholars; Shams al-Dīn Abū al-Khayr Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān al-Sakhāwī, the well-known imam, who heard this fascicle from him, as in the audition records of the fascicle at its end; and among his students also: al-ʿIzz ibn Fahd, al-Burhān al-Biqāʿī, and al-Sharaf ʿAbd al-Ḥaqq al-Sunbāṭī, ﵏.

records.text_ar: ومؤلفاته كالبحر فِيهَا فَوَائِد جمة وعزيزة، غير مَوْجُودَة فِي أَي مَكَان آخر، وَمن أهم تِلْكَ المؤلفات: 1 - فتح الْبَارِي بشرح صَحِيح البُخَارِيّ. وَقد طبع كثيرا. 2 - الْإِصَابَة فِي تَمْيِيز الصَّحَابَة. وَهُوَ مطبوع. 3 - تَهْذِيب التَّهْذِيب. مطبوع. 4 - تقريب التَّهْذِيب. مطبوع. 5 - تَعْجِيل الْمَنْفَعَة بزوائد رجال الْأَئِمَّة الْأَرْبَعَة. مطبوع. 6 - الدُّرَر الكامنة فِي أعين الْمِائَة الثَّامِنَة. مطبوع. 7 - لِسَان الْمِيزَان. مطبوع. 8 - تغليق التَّعْلِيق. مطبوع. وَغير ذَلِك. وَتوفى رَحمَه الله تَعَالَى بعد صَلَاة الْعشَاء الْآخِرَة من لَيْلَة السبت فِي الْيَوْم الثَّامِن وَالْعِشْرين من ذِي الْحجَّة سنة 852 هـ. ولمزيد عَن حَيَاته انْظُر: 1 - الضَّوْء اللامع لأهل الْقرن التَّاسِع للسخاوي (2 / 36) . 2 - شذرات الذَّهَب (7 / 270) . 3 - الْبَدْر الطالع فِي محَاسِن من بعد الْقرن التَّاسِع (1 / 87) . 4 - حسن المحاضرة (1 / 363) . 5 - الْأَعْلَام للزركلي (1 / 178) . وَغير ذَلِك.
records.text_en: His works are like the sea, containing abundant and rare benefits not found anywhere else. Among the most important of these works: 1 - Fatḥ al-Bārī bi-Sharḥ Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī. It has been printed many times. 2 - al-Iṣāba fī Tamyīz al-Ṣaḥāba. Printed. 3 - Tahdhīb al-Tahdhīb. Printed. 4 - Taqrīb al-Tahdhīb. Printed. 5 - Taʿjīl al-Manfaʿa bi-Zawāʾid Rijāl al-Aʾimma al-Arbaʿa. Printed. 6 - al-Durar al-Kāmina fī Aʿyān al-Miʾa al-Thāmina. Printed. 7 - Lisān al-Mīzān. Printed. 8 - Taghlīq al-Taʿlīq. Printed. And others. He ﵀ died after the late-evening prayer (ʿishāʾ) on the night of Saturday, the twenty-eighth day of Dhū al-Ḥijja, in the year 852 AH. For more about his life, see: 1 - al-Ḍawʾ al-Lāmiʿ li-Ahl al-Qarn al-Tāsiʿ by al-Sakhāwī (2/36). 2 - Shadharāt al-Dhahab (7/270). 3 - al-Badr al-Ṭāliʿ fī Maḥāsin man baʿd al-Qarn al-Tāsiʿ (1/87). 4 - Ḥusn al-Muḥāḍara (1/363). 5 - al-Aʿlām by al-Ziriklī (1/178). And others.

records.text_ar: ‌ ‌2 - تَرْجَمَة شيخ ابْن حجر أَبى مُحَمَّد الصردي هُوَ: تَاج الدَّين أَبى مُحَمَّد عبد الْوَاحِد بن ذِي النُّون بن عبد الْغفار بن مُوسَى ابْن إِبْرَاهِيم الصردي - والصردي: بِضَم الْمُهْملَة وَفتح الرَّاء. نِسْبَة إِلَى صرد قَرْيَة بِالْوَجْهِ البحري من الديار المصرية - ولد سنة بضع عشرَة وَسَبْعمائة. وَقد سمع من أَبى الْحسن الواني. وتفقه وناب فِي الحكم بِبَعْض الْقرى. يَقُول الْحَافِظ ابْن حجر فِي تَرْجَمته من " الدُّرَر ": " سَمِعت مِنْهُ (جُزْء سُفْيَان بن عُيَيْنَة) أَنا: الواني، وَقطعَة من صَحِيح مُسلم عَنهُ ". قلت: وَحدث عَنهُ أَبى حَامِد بن ظهيرة، وَغَيره. توفى رحمه الله فِي جُمَادَى الْآخِرَة سنة 797 هـ. انْظُر تَرْجَمته فِي " الدُّرَر الكامنة " (2 / 421) . ‌ ‌3 - تَرْجَمَة شَيْخه: أَبى الْحسن الواني هُوَ: مُسْند مصر: نور الدَّين على بن عمر بن أبي بكر الواني الصُّوفِي. تفرد بِرِوَايَة حَدِيث السلَفِي. وَعرف بِابْن الصّلاح. ولد سنة 637 هـ. وَقد سمع من: ابْن رواج، وأبى الْقَاسِم الطرابلسي سبط السلَفِي، وَكثير غَيرهم. وَخرج لَهُ أَبُو الْحُسَيْن بن أيبك، وَكَانَ سهل القياد، وَتفرد فِي عصره بِرِوَايَة حَدِيث السلَفِي بِالسَّمَاعِ بِغَيْر.
records.text_en: 2 - Biography of Ibn Ḥajar’s shaykh Abū Muḥammad al-Ṣuradī. He is: Tāj al-Dīn Abū Muḥammad ʿAbd al-Wāḥid ibn Dhī al-Nūn ibn ʿAbd al-Ghaffār ibn Mūsā ibn Ibrāhīm al-Ṣuradī — al-Ṣuradī: with a ḍamma on the undotted letter and a fatḥa on the rāʾ; it is a nisba to Ṣurad, a village in the northern part (al-wajh al-baḥrī) of the Egyptian lands — born in the year seven hundred and ten-odd. He heard from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Wānī. He studied jurisprudence and served as deputy in judicial office in some of the villages. Al-Ḥāfiẓ Ibn Ḥajar says in his biography in al-Durar: “I heard from him the [Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna] — al-Wānī informed us — and a section of Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim from him.” I [the editor] said: Abū Ḥāmid ibn Ẓahīra and others also narrated from him. He ﵀ died in Jumādā al-Ākhira in the year 797 AH. See his biography in al-Durar al-Kāmina (2/421). 3 - Biography of his shaykh: Abū al-Ḥasan al-Wānī. He is: the musnid of Egypt, Nūr al-Dīn ʿAlī ibn ʿUmar ibn Abī Bakr al-Wānī al-Ṣūfī. He was singular in transmitting the ḥadīth of al-Silafī. He was known as Ibn al-Ṣalāḥ. He was born in the year 637 AH. He heard from: Ibn Rawāj, Abū al-Qāsim al-Ṭarābulusī, the grandson of al-Silafī, and many others. Abū al-Ḥusayn ibn Aybak compiled a collection of ḥadīths for him, and he was easy to deal with, and he was unique in his era in transmitting the ḥadīth of al-Silafī by audition without.

records.text_ar: وَكَانَ قد أضرّ بِآخِرهِ، ثمَّ عولج فأبصر. قَالَ ابْن حجر فِي " الدُّرَر ": قَالَ ابْن رَافع فِي (جُزْء شُيُوخ مصر) : " هُوَ أسْند من بقى من الشُّيُوخ ". قلت: أَي ابْن حجر -: حَدثنَا عَنهُ الصردي، وَابْن العزبي، والمهدوي، وَمَرْيَم بِالسَّمَاعِ، وَغَيرهم بِالْإِجَازَةِ ". مَاتَ رحمه الله فِي الْمحرم سنة 727 هـ. انْظُر الْمَزِيد عَنهُ فِي: 1 - الدُّرَر الكامنة (3 / 163) . 2 - حسن المحاضرة (1 / 393) . 3 - الْمعِين فِي طَبَقَات الْمُحدثين. للذهبي برقم (2413) . ‌ ‌4 - تَرْجَمَة شَيْخه: أَبى الْقَاسِم الطرابلسي هُوَ: الشَّيْخ الْمسند المعمر أَبُو الْقَاسِم عبد الرَّحْمَن بن الحاسب مكي بن عبد الرَّحْمَن بن أبي سعيد بن عَتيق جمال الدَّين الطرابلسي، ثمَّ الإسْكَنْدراني. سبط الْحَافِظ ابْن طَاهِر. سمع من جده كثيرا. ولد رحمه الله سنة سبعين وَخَمْسمِائة من الْهِجْرَة. وَسمع أَيْضا من ابْن موقا جُزْءا، وَمن بدر الخذاداذي، وَعبد الْمجِيد ابْن دَلِيل، والبوصيري صَاحب زَوَائِد ابْن ماجة وَغير ذَلِك. وَحدث عَنهُ كل من: الإِمَام الْمُنْذِرِيّ صَاحب التَّرْغِيب والترهيب وَغَيره، والدمياطي، وَابْن دَقِيق الْعِيد، والضياء الْمَقْدِسِي، والشهاب الْقَرَافِيّ، وَعبد الرَّحِيم الْخَطِيب الْحَنْبَلِيّ، وَعلي بن عمر الواني، وَعلي بن عبد الْعَظِيم الرسي، وَمُحَمّد بن أَحْمد ابْن الدِّمَاغ، وَغير وَاحِد من الْأَئِمَّة.
records.text_en: And he had become blind towards the end of his life, then was treated and regained his sight. Ibn Ḥajar said in al-Durar: Ibn Rāfiʿ said in (Juzʾ Shuyūkh Miṣr): “He is the most elevated in chain of transmission among the shaykhs who remain.” I [the editor] said — that is, Ibn Ḥajar —: “Al-Ṣuradī, Ibn al-ʿAzabī, al-Mahdawī, and Maryam narrated to us from him by audition, and others by licence (ijāza).” He ﵀ died in Muḥarram of the year 727 AH. See more about him in: 1 - al-Durar al-Kāmina (3/163). 2 - Ḥusn al-Muḥāḍara (1/393). 3 - al-Muʿīn fī Ṭabaqāt al-Muḥaddithīn by al-Dhahabī, no. (2413). 4 - Biography of his shaykh: Abū al-Qāsim al-Ṭarābulusī. He is: the shaykh, the musnid, the long-lived Abū al-Qāsim ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥāsib Makkī ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī Saʿīd ibn ʿAtīq, Jamāl al-Dīn al-Ṭarābulusī, then al-Iskandarānī. Grandson (sibṭ) of al-Ḥāfiẓ Ibn Ṭāhir. He heard much from his grandfather. He ﵀ was born in the year 570 of the Hijra. He also heard a juzʾ from Ibn Mūqā, and heard from Badr al-Khadhādādhī, ʿAbd al-Majīd ibn Dalīl, al-Būṣīrī — author of the Zawāʾid of Ibn Māja — and others. Narrating from him were: Imam al-Mundhirī, author of al-Targhīb wa-l-Tarhīb and other works; al-Dimyāṭī; Ibn Daqīq al-ʿĪd; al-Ḍiyāʾ al-Maqdisī; al-Shihāb al-Qarāfī; ʿAbd al-Raḥīm al-Khaṭīb al-Ḥanbalī; ʿAlī ibn ʿUmar al-Wānī; ʿAlī ibn ʿAbd al-ʿAẓīm al-Rasī; Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad Ibn al-Dimāgh; and more than one of the imams.

records.text_ar: توفى رحمه الله فِي لَيْلَة رَابِع شَوَّال من سنة 651 هـ. انْظُر الْمَزِيد عَنهُ فِي: 1 - السّير للذهبي (13 / 278) . 2 - العبر لَهُ (5 / 208) . 3 - النُّجُوم الزاهرة (7 / 31) . 4 - حسن المحاضرة (1 / 379) . 5 - شذرات الذَّهَب (5 / 253 - 254) . وَغَيرهَا. ‌ ‌5 - تَرْجَمَة شَيْخه: أَبى طَاهِر السلَفِي هُوَ: الإِمَام، الْعَلامَة، الْمُحدث، الْحَافِظ، الْمُفْتى، شيخ الْإِسْلَام، شرف المعمرين، أَبُو طَاهِر أَحْمد بن مُحَمَّد بن أَحْمد بن مُحَمَّد بن إِبْرَاهِيم الْأَصْبَهَانِيّ، ولد الْحَافِظ السلَفِي فِي سنة خمس وَسبعين وَأَرْبَعمِائَة، أَو قبلهَا بِسنة، وَسمع من رزق الله التَّمِيمِي الْحَنْبَلِيّ، وأبى الْحسن الْكُوفِي، وَغير وَاحِد. وَعنهُ سبطه الْمُتَقَدّم آنِفا وَغَيره بِكَثِير. قَالَ أَبُو سعد السَّمْعَانِيّ: " السلَفِي ثِقَة، ورع، مُتَّفق، متثبت، فهم، حَافظ، لَهُ حَظّ من الْعَرَبيَّة، كثير الحَدِيث، حسن الْفَهم والبصيرة ". توفى رَحمَه الله تَعَالَى فِي صَبِيحَة يَوْم الْجُمُعَة خَامِس شهر ربيع الآخر سنة سِتّ وَسبعين وَخمْس مئة من الْهِجْرَة. ولمزيد من التَّفْصِيل عَنهُ انْظُر: 1 - سير أَعْلَام النبلاء (21 / 5 - 39) . 2 - العبر (4 / 227) .
records.text_en: He ﵀ died on the night of the fourth of Shawwāl in the year 651 AH. See more about him in: 1 - al-Siyar by al-Dhahabī (13/278). 2 - al-ʿIbar, also by him (5/208). 3 - al-Nujūm al-Zāhira (7/31). 4 - Ḥusn al-Muḥāḍara (1/379). 5 - Shadharāt al-Dhahab (5/253–254). And others. 5 - Biography of his shaykh: Abū Ṭāhir al-Silafī. He is: the imam, the ʿallāma, the muḥaddith, the ḥāfiẓ, the muftī, Shaykh of Islam, the honor of the long-lived, Abū Ṭāhir Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Ibrāhīm al-Iṣbahānī. Al-Ḥāfiẓ al-Silafī was born in the year 475 AH, or a year before it, and he heard from Rizq Allāh al-Tamīmī al-Ḥanbalī, Abū al-Ḥasan al-Kūfī, and more than one other. Narrating from him: his grandson mentioned above, and many others besides. Abū Saʿd al-Samʿānī said: “Al-Silafī is reliable, pious, agreed upon, meticulous, intelligent, a ḥāfiẓ; he has a share of Arabic, abundant ḥadīth, and fine understanding and insight.” He ﵀ died on the morning of Friday, the fifth of the month of Rabīʿ al-Ākhir, in the year 576 of the Hijra. For more detail about him, see: 1 - Siyar Aʿlām al-Nubalāʾ (21/5–39). 2 - al-ʿIbar (4/227).

records.text_en: 3 - Tadhkirat al-Ḥuffāẓ (4/1298). 4 - Wafayāt al-Aʿyān (1/150). 5 - Ṭabaqāt al-Shāfiʿiyya by Ibn al-Subkī (6/32). 6 - al-Bidāya wa-l-Nihāya by Ibn Kathīr (12/307). 7 - Shadharāt al-Dhahab (4/255). And others. 6 - Biography of his shaykh: Abū al-Ḥasan al-Karajī. He is: the venerable shaykh, the chief, the musnid, the long-lived Abū al-Ḥasan Makkī ibn Manṣūr ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAllān al-Karajī. He was born in the year 397 or 399 AH. He heard from: Abū al-Ḥasan ibn Bishrān, Abū al-Qāsim al-Lālakāʾī, Abū Bakr al-Ḥīrī, Abū Saʿīd al-Ṣayrafī, Muḥammad ibn al-Qāsim al-Fārisī, and others. Narrating from him: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAllān, Abū Ṭāhir al-Silafī, Abū Bakr Aḥmad ibn Naṣr, Abū Zurʿa Ṭāhir ibn Muḥammad al-Maqdisī, and his father, and others. Shīrawayh said of him: “… and there was no harm in him; he was praised among the chiefs, and kind to the poor and to the scholars.” Abū Ṭāhir al-Silafī said: “He was al-Salār [the commander], of exalted rank, whose command was effective, beloved to his subjects for the generosity of his disposition.” He ﵀ died at the end of Jumādā al-Ūlā in the year 491 AH. He is: the imam, the scholar, the muḥaddith, the musnid of Khurāsān, the chief judge Abū Bakr Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAlī al-Ḥasan ibn al-Ḥāfiẓ Abū ʿAmr Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Ḥafṣ al-Ḥarashī al-Ḥīrī al-Naysābūrī al-Shāfiʿī. He was born around the year 325 AH. He narrated from: Abū ʿAlī Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Maʿqil al-Maydānī, Abū al-ʿAbbās al-Aṣamm, Ibn Abī ʿAlī, Abū Bakr ibn Abī Dārim al-Kūfī, Abū Muḥammad al-Fākihī al-Makkī, Bukayr ibn Aḥmad al-Ḥaddād, and others. And from him: al-Ḥākim, author of al-Mustadrak, and others; Abū Muḥammad al-Juwaynī; Abū Bakr al-Bayhaqī; al-Qushayrī, author of al-Risāla; al-Khaṭīb al-Baghdādī; al-Ḥasan ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣaffār; Makkī ibn Manṣūr al-Salār; ʿAlī ibn Aḥmad al-Aḥzam; and others. Al-Ḥākim praised him and exalted his standing. Al-Samʿānī said: “Reliable in ḥadīth.” He died in the month of Ramaḍān in the year 421 AH, at the age of 96. For more about him, see the following: 1 - al-Siyar (17/356). 2 - al-ʿIbar (13/141–142).

He is: the imam, the muḥaddith, the musnid of the age, the destination of journeys of his age: Abū al-ʿAbbās Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb ibn Yūsuf ibn Maʿqil ibn Sinān al-Aṣamm al-Umawī, their client (mawlāhum). He was born in the year 247 AH. He heard from: Aḥmad ibn Yūsuf al-Sulamī, Aḥmad ibn al-Azhar, Asīd ibn ʿĀṣim, Zakariyyā ibn Yaḥyā ibn Asad al-Marwazī, ʿAbbās al-Dūrī, al-Rabīʿ ibn Sulaymān al-Murādī, Muḥammad ibn Hishām ibn Mulās, Yazīd ibn ʿAbd al-Ṣamad, Abū Zurʿa al-Naṣrī, and al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn ʿAffān al-ʿĀmirī — who has a ḥadīth fascicle that I, God willing, am in the process of editing — and others. He narrated the book al-Umm of al-Shāfiʿī from al-Rabīʿ. Narrating from him: al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad ibn Ziyād al-Qabbānī, Ḥassān ibn Muḥammad the jurist, Abū Aḥmad ibn ʿAdī, author of al-Kāmil, Abū Bakr al-Ismāʿīlī, Abū ʿAbd Allāh ibn Mandah, al-Ḥākim, al-Sulamī, Abū Bakr Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ḥīrī, and others. He ﵀ died on the 23rd of Rabīʿ al-Ākhir in the year 346 AH. For more, see the following: 1 - al-Siyar (15/452). 2 - al-Muntaẓam (6/386–387). 3 - al-ʿIbar (2/273–274).

records.text_ar: 4 - الْبِدَايَة وَالنِّهَايَة (11 / 232) . 5 - النُّجُوم الزاهرة (3 / 317) . 6 - شذرات الذَّهَب (2 / 373 - 374) . 7 - تذكرة الْحفاظ (3 / 860 - 864) . وَغير ذَلِك. وَبِذَلِك تَجِد أَن السَّنَد مُتَّصِل وَالْحَمْد لله وَحده، وَمن ذَلِك يتَبَيَّن لَك صِحَة ذَلِك الْجُزْء الْعَظِيم الْفَائِدَة، وَللَّه الْحَمد والْمنَّة. ‌ ‌وصف المخطوط وتوثيقه المخطوط مَحْفُوظ بدار الْكتب القومية المصرية حفظهَا الله من كل سوء، تَحت فن: [حَدِيث: 1831] . ومصور على ميكروفيلم برقم [36031] . وَهَذَا المخطوط يَقع فِي: (21) ورقة. وَقد ضم ثَلَاث مخطوطات. الأولى: جُزْء سُفْيَان بن عُيَيْنَة. وَيَقَع من الورقة: (3 / أ) إِلَى الورقة: (6 / ب) . أَي: [8] صفحات. وَيضم [50] حَدِيثا مُسْندًا. وخطه قديم، بِهِ بعض الْكَلِمَات غير منقوطة. الثَّانِيَة: جُزْء أَبى الجهم الْعَلَاء بن مُوسَى الْبَاهِلِيّ. وَهُوَ قيد التَّحْقِيق. وَيَقَع من (ق 7 / أ) إِلَى (15 / أ) . الثَّالِثَة: " الْأَرْبَعُونَ " لقَاضِي الْقُضَاة عز الدَّين عبد الْعَزِيز بن مُحَمَّد ابْن جمَاعَة، بتخريج الإِمَام أَبى جَعْفَر بن الكويك. وَيَقَع من (ق 15 / ب) إِلَى (ق 22 / أ) وَهُوَ آخر الْمَجْمُوع. والمخطوط لَهُ نُسْخَة أُخْرَى فِي مكتبة الظَّاهِرِيَّة العامرة بِدِمَشْق تَحت فن مَجْمُوع (18 / 12، 13) من (ق 263 / أإِلَى ق 270 / ب) .

Thus you find that the chain of transmission is continuous, praise be to God alone, and from this the soundness of this fascicle of great benefit becomes clear to you; to God belong praise and favor. Description and Authentication of the Manuscript. The manuscript is preserved in Dār al-Kutub al-Qawmiyya al-Miṣriyya, may God protect it from all harm, under the classification: [Ḥadīth: 1831]. It is photographed on microfilm number [36031]. This manuscript comprises (21) folios. It contains three manuscripts. The first: the Fascicle of Sufyān ibn ʿUyayna. It runs from folio (3/a) to folio (6/b), that is, [8] pages. It contains [50] ḥadīths with chains of transmission. Its handwriting is old, and some words are undotted. The second: the Fascicle of Abū al-Jahm al-ʿAlāʾ ibn Mūsā al-Bāhilī. It is currently being edited. It runs from (fol. 7/a) to (15/a). The third: “al-Arbaʿūn” of the chief judge ʿIzz al-Dīn ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn Muḥammad ibn Jamāʿa, with the takhrīj of Imam Abū Jaʿfar ibn al-Kuwayk. It runs from (fol. 15/b) to (fol. 22/a) and is the end of the collection. The manuscript has another copy in the flourishing al-Ẓāhiriyya Library in Damascus under the collection (majmūʿ) (18/12, 13), from (fol. 263/a to fol. 270/b).

records.text_ar: وكتبت تِلْكَ النُّسْخَة فِي الْقرن السَّادِس. ونسخة أُخْرَى فِي الظَّاهِرِيَّة أَيْضا تَحت مَجْمُوع (22 / 7) من (ق 75 / أ) إِلَى (ق 84 / أ) . وكتبت فِي " الْقرن السَّادِس الهجري ". ونسخة ثَالِثَة فِي الظَّاهِرِيَّة أَيْضا تَحت فن " مجاميع " (81) من (ق 113 / أ) إِلَى (ق 128 / ب) . وكتبت فِي سنة 573 هـ. وَهَذِه المعلومات مستفادة من: "تَارِيخ التراث الْعَرَبِيّ" لسيزكين (مج 1 / ج 1 / ص 178 - 179) و (مج 1 / ج 1 / ص 283) . وَأما من نَاحيَة تَوْثِيق الْجُزْء فَهَذَا لَا شكّ فِيهِ. فقد قَالَ الإِمَام الذَّهَبِيّ رحمه الله فِي " السّير " (8 / 466) : " وسُفْيَان حجَّة مُطلقًا، وَحَدِيثه فِي جَمِيع دواوين الْإِسْلَام، وَوَقع لي كثير من عواليه، بل وَعند عبد الرَّحْمَن سبط الْحَافِظ السلَفِي، من عواليه جملَة صَالِحَة مِنْهَا: (جُزْء ابْن عُيَيْنَة) رِوَايَة الْمروزِي عَنهُ … " اهـ. وَهَذَا من أهم التوثيق عِنْدِي. وَكَذَا ذكره فِي تَرْجَمَة أَبى يحيى زَكَرِيَّا بن يحيى بن أَسد الْمروزِي صَاحب الْجُزْء، كَمَا فِي " السّير " (12 / 347) . وَكَذَلِكَ الْحَافِظ ابْن حجر فِي " الدُّرَر الكامنة " (3 / 35) : فِي تَرْجَمَة عبد الْوَاحِد بن ذِي النُّون الصردي. وَقَالَ:
records.text_en: That copy was written in the sixth century. And another copy, also in al-Ẓāhiriyya, under collection (22/7), from (fol. 75/a) to (fol. 84/a). It was written in the “sixth century AH.” And a third copy, also in al-Ẓāhiriyya, under the classification “Collections” (81), from (fol. 113/a) to (fol. 128/b). It was written in the year 573 AH. This information is derived from: “Tārīkh al-Turāth al-ʿArabī” (History of the Arabic Heritage) by Sezgin (vol. 1 / part 1 / pp. 178–179) and (vol. 1 / part 1 / p. 283). As for the authentication of the fascicle, there is no doubt about this. Imam al-Dhahabī ﵀ said in al-Siyar (8/466): “Sufyān is an authority without qualification, and his ḥadīth is in all the compendia of Islam. Many of his elevated narrations have reached me; indeed, with ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, the grandson of al-Ḥāfiẓ al-Silafī, there is a considerable portion of his elevated narrations, among them: (the Fascicle of Ibn ʿUyayna), the narration of al-Marwazī from him …” End of quotation. In my view, this is among the most important authentication. And likewise he mentioned it in the biography of Abū Yaḥyā Zakariyyā ibn Yaḥyā ibn Asad al-Marwazī, the owner of the fascicle, as in al-Siyar (12/347). And likewise al-Ḥāfiẓ Ibn Ḥajar in al-Durar al-Kāmina (3/35): in the biography of ʿAbd al-Wāḥid ibn Dhī al-Nūn al-Ṣuradī. And he said:

records.text_en: “I heard from him (the Fascicle of Ibn ʿUyayna) — al-Wānī informed us …”. Thus it becomes clear to the reader that the fascicle is authenticated in full, and this is part of the completeness of [God’s] favor; so to God belongs praise, first and last.
